title: Connect two local files

outcomes.can: Explain a local export and distinguish strict null checking from the emission target.

intro: A file can expose a named value with export. Another file imports that name from a relative path, such as ./numbers.js. The pack compiles .ts sources to JavaScript modules and runs the emitted .js files locally. import type brings in a type for checking, and that import disappears from emitted code.

steps.title: Predict before running
steps.text: Read the example and predict what happens before checking your answer.

steps.title: Trace the example
steps.text: The example exports a function and then calls it in the same file. In the guided task the helper lives in supplied numbers.ts and is called through an import. The editor’s tsconfig.json describes checking settings. strict enables stricter diagnostics including null checks. target selects the JavaScript version to generate. Changing target does not turn off null checks.

steps.title: Check your explanation
steps.text: Read the indicated code and choose the explanation that accounts for its behavior.

steps.title: Repair a named import
steps.text: The supplied numbers.ts exports starting and add. Export next(delta: number): number. Return add(starting, delta). The starter asks for the wrong export. Use "./numbers.js" as the import path.
